title: Dostai, Father of Rabbi Aptoriki
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Chullin 64b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.64b.3), Dostai, father of Rabbi Aptoriki, recites, “This was taught only when it was found on the egg white,” and so on. [Bava Metzia 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.5a.7-8) calls him only the father of Rabbi Aptoriki. Hyman infers that he was a reciter of baraitot who had not been ordained and that he was known by his son’s name because his son was better known.[^1]

notes.text: Chullin concerns blood in an egg and distinguishes the white from the yolk. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=630&lang=en) also cites the unnamed father’s recitation in Bava Metzia and records Dostai as a form of his name.
